# Public meeting on Station Road flooding

About eighty residents came to the town hall on Thursday to discuss the flooding of Station Road.

Dr Jonathan Pike of the environmental institute explained how the peat bogs upstream hold back rain and slow the flow into the river. The council's structural inspector, Daniel Okafor, said the culvert under Station Road is too narrow for heavy storms.

Mayor Helen Achterberg said the drainage works will start in September. Councillor Priya Nandakumar repeated her call to move them ahead of the Harbour Street resurfacing.
